blocks.text: Macaulay Culkin is set to return as Kevin McCallister in a new “Home Alone” movie, more than three decades after he last played the iconic character on the big screen. Variety reported that a new “Home Alone” film is in early development at Disney’s 20th Century Studios, with Culkin working on the project alongside filmmakers Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg. Rogen and Goldberg are developing the script with Culkin and will also produce the movie through their Point Grey banner. Plot details, additional casting, and a release date have yet to be announced as of this writing. Rolling Stone also reported […]...
